answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
